edge: Start with the problem, not the technology. The initiatives that pay off begin with one specific, costly business problem and a metric to move — not 'let's use AI.'

headlines.summary: The law, which gives the central bank legal powers to manage the transition across the financial system, will now be debated and voted on in the National Assembly.

headlines.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
headlines.summary: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue.

concept.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
concept.body: An LLM is trained on vast text to predict the next word, which is what lets it draft, summarise, and reason over language. It generates plausible text rather than looking up facts — hence its fluency and its habit of confident mistakes ('hallucinations').
concept.takeaway: Lean on LLMs for drafting and synthesis, and keep a human check on high-stakes outputs.
